title: Dedicated capacity allocations per contract - Q2 2026
content:
Overview:
This sheet records per-contract reserved GPU capacity (Dedicated), regional allocation, utilization targets, and short-term action items for Q2 2026. Goal: ensure reserved commitments are mapped to physical pools and flagged for rebalancing before month boundary (2026-04-01).

Legend: Reserved = contract guaranteed GPUs; Buffer = extra GPUs colocated for headroom; Utilization = average active fraction of reserved pool observed over last 30d. Billing monthly is estimated committed charge (not including overage).

Contract allocation table (rows = contracts):

| Contract ID | Customer         | Region  | GPU Type    | Reserved GPUs | Observed 30d Util (%) | Peak 30d Util (%) | Buffer GPUs | Start Date  | End Date    | Billing Tier | Est Monthly $ | On-call / Owner | Notes |
|-------------|------------------|---------|-------------|---------------:|---------------------:|-----------------:|-------------:|------------:|------------:|--------------|--------------:|-----------------|-------|
| DED-1001    | AtlasFin         | us-west | A100-80GB   |             64 |                   72 |               94 |           8  | 2025-10-01  | 2026-12-31  | enterprise   | 43000         | asha.m@redwood.io | Customer using batch-heavy risk-modeling workloads; recommend nightly prefetch cache; plan canaries on N->H switch. |
| DED-1009    | NimbusHealth     | eu-west | H100        |             48 |                   58 |               81 |           6  | 2026-01-15  | 2027-01-14  | standard     | 36000         | lena.p@redwood.io | Observed bursty spikes THU-FRI; add autoscale policy linked to queue length. |
| DED-1016    | VerdiRetail      | ap-northeast | L40S    |             32 |                   41 |               63 |           4  | 2026-03-01  | 2026-09-30  | standard     | 19800         | marcus.w@redwood.io | Customer expects holiday peak; consider temporary burst credits for Jul-Sep. |
| DED-1022    | DataLayer Labs   | us-east | A100-80GB   |             16 |                   88 |              100 |           2  | 2025-06-01  | 2026-06-30  | enterprise   | 11200         | diego.r@redwood.io | Near-saturation — contract renewal negotiation in May; prepare downgrade options and fallback to hosted variants. |

Regional capacity snapshot (physical pools) — snapshot date 2026-03-03:

| Region   | Total GPUs (physical) | Reserved (sum) | Reserved % of region | Free unreserved GPUs | Notes |
|----------|----------------------:|---------------:|--------------------:|---------------------:|-------|
| us-west  | 640                   | 192            | 30%                 | 120                  | 8x A100 racks, maintenance window Sun 02:00-06:00 PST. |
| eu-west  | 512                   | 96             | 19%                 | 160                  | OOM events on H100 hosts last month; patch scheduled. |
| ap-northeast | 384               | 64             | 17%                 | 88                   | Network egress accounting differs; confirm billback. |
| us-east  | 320                   | 48             | 15%                 | 80                   | Older A100 nodes planned replacement Q3. |

Key observations and risks:
- Two contracts (DED-1001, DED-1022) are at or above 85% sustained utilization — risk of SLA incidents if an availability domain goes down.
- us-west pool has high reservation concentration; single rack maintenance causes >5% contractual impact.
- Billing estimates do not include scheduled overage credits; finance needs per-contract amortization for Q2 forecasts.

Action items (owner, due):
- Rebalance suggestion: Move 8 GPUs from us-west free pool to us-east physical replication to reduce single-region concentration (owner: diego.r, due: 2026-03-20).
- Autoscale: Implement burst policy for NimbusHealth (DED-1009) to allow +12 GPUs on spot-backed hosts (owner: lena.p, due: 2026-03-25).
- Renewal prep: Draft downgrade/rollback playbook for DataLayer Labs if renewal fails (owner: asha.m, due: 2026-04-10).
- Cost: Finance to confirm monthly amortized GPU cost per model (owner: finance-team, due: 2026-03-15).

Assumptions and notes for planners:
- 'Reserved GPUs' counts reflect vGPU-equivalent slots (we map multi-GPU model footprints into a standard unit).
- Buffer GPUs are colocated within same AZ where possible; if AZ-constrained, cross-AZ buffer is allowed with SLA-exception.
- Observed 30d Utilization computed from runtime metering excluding prewarming/keepalive tokens.

Change log (short):
- 2026-03-04: initial draft populated from INFRA-7421 telemetry export (Diego).
- 2026-03-07: adjusted NimbusHealth observed peaks after log reprocessing (Lena).
- 2026-03-10: added action items and regional snapshot; set in_review.

End of sheet.
